Name: AutoSorting
Author: TheFroggyBoy
Description:
Hi, this is a simple mod to make our lives easier while playing, inspired by the autosorting system in Terraria.

If you have an item in any type of chest nearby (4> tiles), it autodeposits the same items from your inventory into it.
It also works with fridges!

How to use:

K: Press K to sort items in the chests.
L: Press L to "favorite" an item, marked by a red star, to prevent it from being moved from said place. Works the same way as in Terraria.

Have fun!

- TheFroggyBoy
